items.name: List All Power Plans
items.description: Enumerates all schemes with GUIDs for management and diff workflows.

items.name: Clone Current Plan (snapshot-ready)
items.description: Duplicates the active scheme so aggressive edits can be isolated to a clone.

steps.command: $active=(powercfg /getactivescheme | Out-String); if($active -match "([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})"){ $guid=$Matches[1]; powercfg /duplicatescheme $guid | Write-Output } else { throw "Could not parse active scheme GUID." }

items.name: Export Active Plan Snapshot (.pow)
items.description: Exports the current active plan to logs/power-exports so you can rollback after experimental changes.

steps.command: $active=(powercfg /getactivescheme | Out-String); if($active -match "([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})"){ $guid=$Matches[1] } else { throw "Could not parse active scheme GUID." }; $ts=Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"; $dir=Join-Path (Join-Path $PWD "logs") "power-exports"; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir | Out-Null }; $file=Join-Path $dir ("active-scheme-"+$ts+".pow"); powercfg /export $file $guid; Write-Output "Saved: $file"

items.name: Set Active Plan: Ultimate Performance
items.description: Creates Ultimate Performance if needed and activates it.

items.name: Reset Power Plans to Windows Defaults
items.description: Emergency reset for broken plan state. Exports should be created first because this removes custom plans.
